kill_fact: The catalyst is genuine, signed, dated and binding - and that is exactly why nothing is left in it. The spread is not thin; on current prices it is NEGATIVE. AXTA printed $33.74 on 27 July 2026 (+2.99% on the session; the file's $32.76 is the 24 July prior close), while AkzoNobel printed EUR 58.44, not the EUR 59.26 the file's target is built on. Recomputing the terms with the file's OWN method and its own EUR 13.76 per-share pre-completion-distribution deduction, at EUR/USD 1.13753: (58.44 - 13.76) x 0.6539 x 1.13753 = $33.24 - below the live price. The board's $42.64 is an arithmetic artifact that multiplies the 0.6539 ratio by AkzoNobel's price while ignoring the EUR 2.5bn cash distribution AkzoNobel pays only its own shareholders; the registered prospectus does the sum properly at about $34.36 with AkzoNobel at EUR 59.94 on 23 June 2026, against the $44.61 the naive multiplication gives. Worse, the EUR 13.76 deduction is back-solved, not disclosed, and does not survive cross-checking: the prospectus's 17 November 2025 anchor ($30.25 at EUR 56.64 / 1.159) back-solves to EUR 16.73, and the gross EUR 2.5bn over AkzoNobel's roughly 171m shares is EUR 14.62 - putting today's terms at $31.60 and $32.60 respectively. In every one of the three defensible constructions AXTA at $33.74 is trading AT or THROUGH the deal terms, by 1.5% to 6.4%. The market's implied completion probability has gone above 100%. Against that, the downside to the $28.17 undisturbed close is now 16.5%, and there is no contractual floor at all: all stock, no collar, no cash alternative, no termination payment to Axalta holders, so the position is functionally an unhedged euro-denominated long in AkzoNobel with negative carry, carrying a live FTC second request (20 February 2026) over a real horizontal overlap in vehicle refinish. The only hard date, the 5 August 2026 vote, is a gating condition that pays nothing; the value-realising event is antitrust clearance across roughly 30 jurisdictions with no date at all, and the binding end date is 18 May 2027 extendable to 18 November 2027. Every structural claim in the bear file verified against primary sources - its arithmetic is simply one session stale, in the direction that kills the trade.
